title: 第482章 抱歉我有老公了他叫林默第481章 神明选妃殷血被看上了
slug: 我妈等着治病你召唤我当勇者
content_zh:
第482章抱歉我有老公了，他叫林默
“小妹妹，有没有兴趣跟本神去神界生活啊？”
听到这话殷血显然愣了一下。
她活了不知多少年，被人怕过，被人恨过，被人当成魔王追杀过，但被人当成“小妹妹”当街调戏，这还真是头一回。
周围的百姓们纷纷回头看向这个被神明亲自点名的小家伙，目光里满是好奇与艳羡。
几个挎着菜篮子的老妪眯着眼端详着殷血，嘴里啧啧称赞。
旁边几个商贩也跟着起哄。
殷血只觉得一阵恶寒从翅膀尖直窜到脚底板。
她下意识地低头看了看自己——巴掌大的个头，圆脸，红发，翅膀还没成年蝙蝠大。
她在心里把那个神明的祖上十八代连同他的审美品味一起骂了个遍。
那个神明见殷血没有立刻拒绝，以为自己这番深情告白已经打动了这位红发小美人。
他从台阶上缓步走下，银灰色长袍在石板路上拖出优雅的弧线，所过之处百姓们纷纷躬身行礼，自动为他让出一条通道。
他走到林默面前停住，微微弯腰，用一种自以为最温柔、最有风度的语调对殷血伸出手。
“跟我一起去神界生活吧，我在神界的宫殿比这座城还要大，你想要什么就有什么。”
殷血缓缓转头看向林默，却发现这家伙正靠在石柱上，嘴角挂着一个极其明显的坏笑。
那表情殷血太熟悉了。
他根本不打算替她解围，他就在那看戏。
殷血在心里骂了一句脏话，然后她想到了极佳的报复手段。
她脸上的恶心瞬间切换成一副天真烂漫的表情。
然后伸出两只小手环抱住林默的脖子，在他脸颊上结结实实地亲了一大口。

这才转头朝那个神明露出一个极其抱歉的甜美微笑。
“抱歉哦，我已经有老公了。这就是我家那位，你看，是不是很帅？”
林默嘴角那抹坏笑瞬间凝固了。
他侧头看了一眼还挂在自己脖子上的殷血，她眉眼之间透露着一副娇滴滴的模样。
但更深处的那一丝狡黠林默看的清清楚楚。
那个神明的眉头极其细微地皱了一下，目光在殷血环着林默脖子的手上停留了一瞬。
但很快他的眉头便重新舒展开来，脸上的笑容甚至比之前更加温和、更加宽容。
他直起身，将手背到身后，用一种大义凛然、仿佛在宣读一段伟大牺牲宣言的语调说道。
“没关系，我不嫌弃你，即便你曾经嫁过人，本神也愿意接纳你，这是——本神的仁慈。”
全场百姓都被这位神明的“宽容”感动了。
几个老妪甚至开始用手帕擦着眼角。
那位神明似乎很满意自己这句话的效果，脸上的得意之色越来越浓郁。
content_en:
Chapter 482 Sorry, I have a husband, his name is Lin Mo
"Little sister, are you interested in living with me in the God Realm?"
Yin Xue was obviously stunned when he heard this.
She had lived for who knows how many years, and had been feared, hated, and chased as a devil, but this was the first time that she had been teased in the street as a "little sister."
The people around him turned to look at the little guy named by the god himself, their eyes full of curiosity and envy.
Several old women carrying vegetable baskets looked at Yin Xue with squinted eyes and praised him.
Several vendors nearby also started making noises.
Yin Xue felt a chill running from the tips of his wings to the soles of his feet.
She subconsciously looked down at herself - she was as big as a palm, with a round face, red hair, and wings no bigger than an adult bat.
In her mind, she scolded the eighteenth generation of that god's ancestor and his aesthetic taste.
When the god saw that Yin Xue did not refuse immediately, he thought that his affectionate confession had already impressed the red-haired beauty.
He walked down the steps slowly, his silver-gray robe drawing an elegant arc on the stone road. Wherever he passed, people bowed and saluted, automatically making way for him.
He stopped in front of Lin Mo, bent down slightly, and stretched out his hand to Yin Xue in what he thought was the gentlest and most graceful tone.
"Come with me to live in the God Realm. My palace in the God Realm is bigger than this city. You can have whatever you want."
Yin Xue slowly turned his head to look at Lin Mo, only to find that this guy was leaning against the stone pillar with a very obvious evil smile hanging on the corner of his mouth.
That expression was all too familiar to Yin Xue.
He had no intention of rescuing her, he was just watching the show.
Yin Xue cursed in her heart, and then she thought of an excellent way to get revenge.
The disgust on her face instantly switched to an expression of innocence.
Then he stretched out his two small hands and hugged Lin Mo's neck, giving him a firm kiss on the cheek.
Then he turned his head and showed an extremely apologetic and sweet smile to the god.
"Sorry, I already have a husband. This is my husband. Look, isn't he handsome?"
The evil smile on Lin Mo's lips froze instantly.
He glanced sideways at Yin Xue, who was still hanging around his neck. There was a delicate look between her eyebrows.
But Lin Mo could clearly see the hint of cunning deeper inside.
The god's brows furrowed slightly, and his eyes lingered on Yin Xue's hand around Lin Mo's neck for a moment.
But soon his brows stretched again, and the smile on his face was even gentler and more tolerant than before.
He straightened up, put his hands behind his back, and spoke in a solemn and awe-inspiring tone, as if he was reciting a declaration of great sacrifice.
"It doesn't matter, I don't dislike you. Even if you have been married before, I am still willing to accept you. This is the mercy of this God."
All the people present were moved by this god's "tolerance".
A few old women even started wiping their eyes with handkerchiefs.
The god seemed to be very satisfied with the effect of his words, and the look of pride on his face became more and more intense.
